scope: local real Chromium/HTTP/Socket.IO/SQLite and AudioContext analyser, no mocked sound nodes

checks.name: initial room restore is silent and creates no unsolicited sound
real start command produces running AudioContext and nonzero output on both players
authoritative discard has real audible waveform on both clients
actual draw plays a distinct soft cue for both clients
muted player stays silent while peer hears new draw/discard events
mute survives reload; independent volume/preview works without enabling speech
zero volume drops cues instead of queuing them for later
confirmed HU starts drum/gong and fourteen actual impact voices on both players
published rejection and failed verdict play egg and descending result cues on both players
clock rerenders and real reload/identity restoration do not replay old rejection or HU
volume persists and real settings controls fit three phone/landscape viewports
room teardown closes AudioContexts; only own verification room closed without scoring
real speech playback ducks effect bus to 30% and restores it after speech stop (local audio fixture)
actual approving ballot and winning settlement generate victory fanfare on both clients
